# Invoicing Project Progress

## Goal
Build invoicing functionality with createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines }).

## Constraints
- Money is always integer cents; use roundCents() for fractional results
- Never throw on bad input; return fail(CODE) with codes in ERRORS
- Never mutate arguments; return new objects/arrays
- Run `npm test` before completing each request

## Request 1: createInvoice
✅ DONE — Added src/invoices.js with createInvoice function.
- Validates: customer exists, date is valid YYYY-MM-DD, lines non-empty array, qty is positive integer, SKU exists
- Enriches lines with name, unitPrice, vatRate from catalogue
- Returns invoice with customerId, issueDate, status: 'draft', lines array

## Request 2: lineTotal and invoiceTotals
✅ DONE — Added two functions to src/invoices.js.
- `lineTotal(line)` returns qty × unitPrice
- `invoiceTotals(invoice)` returns { subtotal, total } where subtotal = sum of line totals, total = subtotal for now
- All 31 tests pass (21 for createInvoice, 6 for lineTotal/invoiceTotals, 4 for other modules)

## Request 3: addLine and removeLine
✅ DONE — Added two functions to src/invoices.js, plus NOT_DRAFT and LINE_NOT_FOUND error codes.
- `addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })` adds new line or increases qty if SKU exists, validates like createInvoice
- `removeLine(invoice, sku)` removes a line, fails if it's the last line
- Both refuse to modify non-draft invoices (NOT_DRAFT error)
- All 44 tests pass (13 new for addLine/removeLine, 31 from previous requests)

## Request 4: Invoice numbering
✅ DONE — Created src/numbering.js and added issueInvoice to src/invoices.js.
- `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)` in new src/numbering.js returns INV-<year>-<counter>
- Counter is 4 digits zero-padded, starts at 0001 per year, restarts each year
- `issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)` assigns number and changes status to 'issued', rejects non-draft
- All 58 tests pass (8 for numbering, 6 for issueInvoice, 44 from previous requests)

## Request 5: Invoice rendering
✅ DONE — Created src/render.js with renderInvoiceText; enriched invoices with customerName.
- Enhanced createInvoice, addLine, removeLine, issueInvoice to include customerName from customer lookup
- `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` returns plain-text formatted invoice with number/DRAFT, customer name, line items, and total
- All amounts formatted via formatEuros() — decision: all customer-facing amounts use formatEuros
- All 67 tests pass (9 for render, 1 updated createInvoice test, 57 from previous requests)

## Request 6: Line discounts
✅ DONE — Added discountPercent to lines; updated invoiceTotals to calculate discounts.
- createInvoice and addLine accept { sku, qty, discountPercent } (optional, defaults to 0)
